profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Application engineer who is passionate about producing DRY, maintainable code and seamless user experience. I am interested in working in startups with functional teams and honing my technical leadership skills.

- Back end: NodeJS/Typescript, Ruby/Rails, Python/Flask, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Snowflake.
- Front end: ReactJS, EmberJS, AngularJS.
- Experience with service-oriented APIs, distributed systems, and continuous integration/deployment.
- Tools: git, bash, Datadog, AWS.

Check out my website http://nessanguyen.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained Fulfillment Service, a core microservice integrating with pharmacy systems to automate order creation and fulfillment workflows.
• Improved operational visibility by triaging and categorizing order issues, introducing order status transition tracking, building Looker dashboards for stuck-order monitoring, and implementing real-time order status updates in Rails ActiveAdmin via Kafka events.
• Enhanced reliability across distributed systems by improving idempotency and addressing communication bottlenecks between Fulfillment Service, the legacy Rails platform, and Commerce Service.
• Increased application performance and stability by tackling technical debt, reducing unnecessary third-party API calls (DoseSpot, ShipEngine), and consolidating prescription data.
• Championed engineering excellence through code reviews, linting standards, technical documentation, and monthly Patch Tuesday initiatives to keep applications and dependencies secure and up to date.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · NestJS · TypeScript · Ruby · Node.js · CircleCI · Datadog

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Part of the Internal Efficiency team, building tools that enabled mortgage operations teams to discover, prioritize, and complete work more efficiently.
• Served as technical lead for multiple mid-sized initiatives, including the design and development of a Ticket Service for managing and resolving customer issues (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, TypeORM).
• Built and maintained internal tools and user interfaces across React and legacy Ember applications, supporting key workflows for mortgage operations teams.
• Supported system reliability through incident response, performance monitoring, and operational improvements using Datadog and PagerDuty.
• Reduced technical debt through JS to TypeScript refactoring efforts. Improved performance of staff-facing application by optimizing API responses, reducing payload sizes, and eliminating excessive data cached in the Ember Data Store.
• Improved engineering productivity and code quality through code reviews, linting improvements, faster Docker build pipelines, and technical documentation.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Engineer, Publisher Features (April 2018 - October 2019)
• Lead the rebuild of Publisher Dashboard and Cart Explorer, which aggregated stats about most popular articles, links and products (Python/Flask, Snowflake, Postgres, ElasticSearch)
• Planned and oversaw execution of new projects/features while paring down tech debt
• Spearheaded frontend migration from Angular 1.5 to React

Software Engineer 2016-2018
• Lead several new features and redesigns in Narrativ's single-page Angular dashboard application (Angular 1.5)
• Developed API endpoints corresponding to the dashboard app (Python, Flask)
• Worked on Javascript tags that dynamically update e-commerce links and track user actions on clients' websites (Node, Javascript)
• Collaborated with others through code reviews and documentation, upheld code quality and reliability through refactoring and writing automated tests

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained the service-oriented Sportsrocket API and its queue-based processes (Ruby, Rails, SQS)
• Worked on several Rails APIs handling user authentication, payments, and geo-blocking, optimized performance with caching.
• Implemented new features for the HTML5 video player and Boxxspring content management system (Angular, Javascript)
• Revamped the video analytics process, which collected 800k+ events daily (AWS Lambda, Redshift, Cassandra, ElasticSearch)
• Monitored application performance (AppSignal, NewRelic, Cloudwatch), reponded to on-call emergencies, handled database backup & migration

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built front-end features (carousel, lazy loading, responsiveness) and optimized Waywire.com for mobile
• Fixed bugs and added features to Waywire Enterprise's video management system (Angular, SASS)
• Designed and built an internal tool for content editors to manage video channels (Rails, MySQL, Backbone)

positions.title: Email Marketing Associate
positions.description:
• Designed and coded reliable HTML emails using Photoshop and Dreamweaver
• Deployed high-volume email campaigns with Silverpop, utilized A/B testing & optimization tactics
• Managed and segmented a 200,000-contact database, devise audience development strategies
• Assisted with strategizing marketing automation and retargeting campaigns, data reporting
